TR-DOS
====
## TR-DOS for ZX-Spectrum BetaDisc interface
<!-- This file is automatically generated. Do not edit. -->

The BetaDisc interface for the ZX-Spectrum by Technology research came with a simple
operating system in ROM named TR-DOS. The controller is a standard 1793 chip,
widespread at the time. 40 or 80 tracks, one or two sides, 16 sectors per track,
sector size is 256 bytes. Side byte in sector ID record is not used and always
set to 0.

FluxEngine can read and write these.

## Options

  - Format variants:
      - `640dsdd`: 640kB 80-track double-sided
      - `320ssdd`: 320kB 80-track single-sided
      - `320dsdd`: 320kB 40-track double-sided
      - `160sssd`: 160kB 40-track single-sided

## Examples

To read:

  - `fluxengine read -c trdos --640dsdd -s drive:0 -o trdos.trd`
  - `fluxengine read -c trdos --320ssdd -s drive:0 -o trdos.trd`
  - `fluxengine read -c trdos --320dsdd -s drive:0 -o trdos.trd`
  - `fluxengine read -c trdos --160sssd -s drive:0 -o trdos.trd`

To write:

  - `fluxengine write -c trdos --640dsdd -d drive:0 -i trdos.trd`
  - `fluxengine write -c trdos --320ssdd -d drive:0 -i trdos.trd`
  - `fluxengine write -c trdos --320dsdd -d drive:0 -i trdos.trd`
  - `fluxengine write -c trdos --160sssd -d drive:0 -i trdos.trd`
